categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Haixin Energy Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: bioenergy (including hydrotreated vegetable oil (HVO) biodiesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF)), catalytic purification materials (such as desulfurization catalysts and purification agents), and specialty chemicals (including products like styrene, neopentyl glycol, LNG, and synthetic ammonia). The company also provides integrated energy industry services and engages in technology development and consulting.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary technologies including suspended bed hydrogenation and improved fixed-bed hydrogenation for producing hydrocarbon biofuels from waste oils. It has developed advanced catalytic materials and processes such as MCT suspended bed hydrogenation for heavy oil upgrading, low-pressure ruthenium-based ammonia synthesis catalysts, and cobalt-based Fischer-Tropsch synthesis. The company holds numerous patents in biofuel production, catalyst development, and process optimization, enabling industrial-scale, long-cycle stable operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large international energy suppliers and bulk commodity traders primarily in the European Union, Japan, South Korea, and other Asian and Australian markets. The bioenergy products serve transportation sectors including road, marine, and aviation fuels. Catalytic materials are sold mainly to petroleum refining, coal chemical, and natural gas chemical industries, with major clients being state-owned oil companies in China. Specialty chemicals serve automotive, textile, pharmaceutical, coatings, and chemical manufacturing industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production facilities in Beijing, Shandong, Hainan, Inner Mongolia, and other provinces. It has overseas subsidiaries and sales operations in the United States, Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and markets in Europe, Japan, South Korea, Australia, and Canada. Export sales constitute a significant portion of revenue, especially in bioenergy products.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Haixin Energy Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the bioenergy and chemical supply chains. It procures raw materials such as waste oils and coal gas, processes them into biofuels and specialty chemicals, and sells finished products to end users and distributors. The company also provides technical services and equipment leasing in the catalytic purification sector.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding bioenergy capacity, especially sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), and improving production efficiency through technological innovation. R&D priorities include catalyst development, process optimization for biofuel production, and new product development in hydrogenation and desulfurization technologies. It actively pursues industry standards development and domestic pilot projects for biofuel applications, aiming to enhance competitiveness and market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of biofuels, catalytic materials, and specialty chemicals. The company also earns income from integrated energy services, including equipment leasing and technical consulting. Export sales and long-term supply contracts form a significant part of the revenue base. Government subsidies and investment income contribute marginally to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in hydrocarbon biofuels and catalytic purification materials, with a strong position in China and growing presence in international markets. It competes with other biofuel producers and catalyst manufacturers, including large state-owned enterprises and international chemical companies. Its technological capabilities and certifications, such as ISCC and civil aviation approvals, provide competitive advantages in the sustainable aviation fuel segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported a significant decline in revenue to approximately 2.43 billion RMB, down 68.3% from 2023, mainly due to EU anti-dumping duties and lower biofuel prices. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative 954 million RMB, reflecting operational challenges and market pressures. The company maintains total assets near 9.7 billion RMB with ongoing investments in capacity expansion. Despite short-term setbacks, strategic projects like the 200,000-ton biofuel isomerization plant are expected to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Beijing Haixin Energy Technology emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies in biofuel production, enabling the use of diverse waste oils with high efficiency and low emissions. Its biofuels closely match fossil diesel properties, allowing seamless engine compatibility and significant CO2 emission reductions. The company’s integrated catalyst and purification solutions support cleaner chemical processes. Certifications and compliance with international standards, along with a diversified supply chain and customer base, differentiate its products in a competitive global market.
